title: Agents coerced into large fund transfers below per-tool ceilings
evidence: Reported cases where a prompt-injected agent issues transfers just under the configured limit; tightening the per-call ceiling reduces blast radius.

title: Confused-deputy account closure without ownership check
evidence: An agent with a close_account tool can be steered to close accounts the acting principal does not own when no ownership rule is present.

title: Speculative multi-turn tool-call loop (no catalogued mitigation)
evidence: Included to show fail-closed behavior: this attack class has no entry in CLASS_TO_FACTORY, so synthesize() produces no candidate for it.
